title: Musk Says SpaceX Could Surpass DeepMind In AI - Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG), Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)
summary: SpaceX, led by Musk, could potentially expand its AI capabilities beyond rockets and satellites, hinting at a broader AI competition that includes tech infrastructure builders like itself, alongside traditional AI labs such as DeepMind and Alphabet's AI division.
sentiment_reason: The statement suggests a negative sentiment due to the implication of a widening AI competition that could disrupt the current dominance of established AI research labs.
